crew.overview: With one coin to make a wish at the piazza fountain, a peasant girl encounters two competing street performers who'd prefer the coin find its way into their tip jars. The little girl, Tippy, is caught in the middle as a musical duel ensues between the one-man-bands.
crew.title: One Man Band

crew.overview: A young boy comes of age in the most peculiar of circumstances. Tonight is the very first time his Papa and Grandpa are taking him to work. In an old wooden boat they row far out to sea, and with no land in sight, they stop and wait. A big surprise awaits the boy as he discovers his family's most unusual line of work. Should he follow the example of his Papa, or his Grandpa? Will he be able to find his own way in the midst of their conflicting opinions and timeworn traditions?
crew.title: La luna

crew.overview: What lengths will a robot undergo to do his job? BURN·E is a dedicated hard working robot who finds himself locked out of his ship. BURN·E quickly learns that completing a simple task can often be a very difficult endeavor.
crew.title: BURN·E

crew.overview: When an overconfident teen alien gets behind the controls of a spaceship, he must attempt to abduct a slumbering farmer under the watchful eye of a critical instructor. But abducting humans requires precision and a gentle touch, and within a few missteps it's painfully clear why more humans don't go missing every year.
crew.title: Lifted

crew.overview: A look at the relationship between Mike and Sulley during their days at Monsters University — when they weren't necessarily the best of friends.
crew.title: Monsters University

crew.overview: Nemo, an adventurous young clownfish, is unexpectedly taken from his Great Barrier Reef home to a dentist's office aquarium. It's up to his worrisome father Marlin and a friendly but forgetful fish Dory to bring Nemo home -- meeting vegetarian sharks, surfer dude turtles, hypnotic jellyfish, hungry seagulls, and more along the way.
crew.title: Finding Nemo

crew.overview: Despite his family’s baffling generations-old ban on music, Miguel dreams of becoming an accomplished musician like his idol, Ernesto de la Cruz. Desperate to prove his talent, Miguel finds himself in the stunning and colorful Land of the Dead following a mysterious chain of events. Along the way, he meets charming trickster Hector, and together, they set off on an extraordinary journey to unlock the real story behind Miguel's family history.
crew.title: Coco

crew.overview: Thirteen-year-old Mei is experiencing the awkwardness of being a teenager with a twist – when she gets too excited, she transforms into a giant red panda.
crew.title: Turning Red

crew.overview: It ain't easy bein' green -- especially if you're a likable (albeit smelly) ogre named Shrek. On a mission to retrieve a gorgeous princess from the clutches of a fire-breathing dragon, Shrek teams up with an unlikely compatriot -- a wisecracking donkey.
crew.title: Shrek

crew.overview: Dory is reunited with her friends Nemo and Marlin in the search for answers about her past. What can she remember? Who are her parents? And where did she learn to speak Whale?
crew.title: Finding Dory

crew.overview: Woody has always been confident about his place in the world and that his priority is taking care of his kid, whether that's Andy or Bonnie. But when Bonnie adds a reluctant new toy called "Forky" to her room, a road trip adventure alongside old and new friends will show Woody how big the world can be for a toy.
crew.title: Toy Story 4

crew.overview: Legendary Space Ranger Buzz Lightyear embarks on an intergalactic adventure alongside a group of ambitious recruits and his robot companion Sox.
crew.title: Lightyear

details.biography:
Steve Bloom is an award-winning American film editor with over 30 years of experience in film, television, and documentary production. He is a member of the American Cinema Editors (ACE) and has worked with major studios such as Industrial Light & Magic (ILM), DreamWorks PDI, and Pixar. Bloom began working at Pixar in the early 2000s, initially being offered an opening for editing short films before moving on to full-length features.

His editing credits include James and the Giant Peach, Antz, Monsters University, Coco, Toy Story 4, Turning Red, and Elio. He was also involved in ILM’s canceled CG Frankenstein project and contributed as an additional editor on Shrek and an assistant editor on Mars Attacks, though he remained uncredited on those projects due to his limited involvement (He edited approximately 8 to 9 minutes of Shrek’s footage, according to his own account).

Bloom’s favorite Pixar films are The Incredibles, Inside Out, Ratatouille, Toy Story 3, and Coco. His least favorite is Cars 2, he doesn’t like the Cars series in general, but he told me not to say that online (oops)
details.name: Steve Bloom
